policy.supportRule: A physical device is supported only after its exact model and SKU, unlock path, vendor interface, hardware, signed OTA rollback and stock recovery have passed on-device acceptance.
policy.fallbackRule: When native OS installation is unavailable, expose the RockstarOS experience through a least-privilege client and approved remote execution instead of claiming OS replacement.

required: exact model and regional SKU identity
kernel, device tree, vendor modules and VINTF compatibility
display, input, storage, USB, networking, radio, camera, audio, power and thermal capability results
signed Virtual A/B OTA and failed-update rollback evidence
stock recovery procedure and verified artifacts
data schema migration and backup restore evidence
mustRemainSeparate: RockstarOS common services and application contracts
OS update and user data migration

targets.notes: Buildroot ARM64 reference image. It is not evidence for any phone.
Device-independent Android integration target for common Sky, Wallet, Game and update contracts.
Deferred until the Pixel 10 first target passes its physical acceptance. No full build, flash, boot, OTA or recovery acceptance.

Owner-selected first physical target. Read-only ADB confirmed Pixel 10 / frankel / Japan-market GL066 on 2026-09-16. Standalone test-signed APK instrumentation, offline GGUF inference, reboot persistence and a 33-minute thermal run passed on the existing OS. Full build, avocadoOS flash, boot, OTA and recovery acceptance remain pending.
Treble and bootloader unlock are prerequisites; a generic flashing or hardware-support claim is prohibited.
Promote to experimental native OS only after an exact model exposes a supported unlock, vendor and recovery path.
Research is separate from a maintained product and cannot be advertised as supported.
Provide an iOS or web client; do not claim replacement of the Apple secure-boot operating system.
